race.comment: Tough race. SUMMER'S LEGACY (2) might find this a bit sharp but this is the easiest race she has contested in a long while. Will get back but storm home. AIN'TSOBAD (5) will find this easier than last time when sixth at Belmont Park. LOOKS like one of the major players. BUDERIM (6) has a far better draw this time and will take catching. TOO MUCH TALK (4) is a last-start winner when he scored by 1.3 lengths at Pinjarra Scarpside over 1500m. Can measure up again. MY JIMMY (13) is third-up. Was in the money first up then couldn't repeat the feat when sixth last time out over 1300m at Northam. Can atone.
